annotations.title: Owned versus missing in a collection

description: Missing items in one collection for one install. A list row is public after 3 installs agree on the collection, the source, and the item. Owned is what that install uploaded. Not a Blizzard profile read and not a copied catalog. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

ownerInstallId.description: Install id whose owned upload to compare.

name: collection_gap

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

groups.description: Catalog entries 3 installs agree on, grouped by source, split by the install's own upload.

ownedRecorded.description: False when this install never uploaded this collection: owned is unknown, not empty.

queued.description: Catalog entries fewer than 3 installs reported yet.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

title: Owned versus missing in a collection
